summary_1line: Shiva explains his four faces, bull mount, cremation-ground dwelling, and then expounds duties of householders, castes, and the paths of worldly duty and renunciation.

image_candidates.scene_text: As the beautiful Tilottama circles him, Shiva sprouts four faces in different directions so he can keep gazing at her.
Blue‑throated Shiva stands with matted hair and the bow Pinaka, surrounded by ghostly beings in a cremation ground strewn with bones and funeral pyres.
Uma questions Shiva while seated beside him as sages gather around, listening reverently to his discourse on dharma.
